$comment: HAND-EDITED. The content-level pass over catalogue.json: what collapses, what splits, what moves, what gets retired. Every catalogue entry must appear exactly once, keyed by its URL without scheme or trailing slash; scripts/build-rethink.mjs refuses to build otherwise. Entries prefixed '+' are not in the catalogue yet (from the coverage backlog). Actions: keep (unchanged) · fold (was top-level, becomes a page inside a hub) · regroup (a page moved to a different hub) · merge (retired as an entry; its URL stays, its content is covered by the target) · retire (frozen versions and scaffolding: drop from the catalogue, declare as content) · promote (a page becomes a top-level site) · new (listed for the first time) · decide (a human has to choose) · look (nobody has written down what this is yet; placement is a guess). A top group may carry pinned:true — a category the landing shows first. Members may carry tech[] (seed · genome · certify · judge · grow · measure): the shared procgen vocabulary the /procgen/ page is organised by; and domain:'procgen' cross-lists a member that lives in another pack. A top group may carry blurb: the one-line visitor-facing description the landing uses when its door has none. wings[] is the level above hubs — the landing's first ring and the shelf's sections; each top group and each standalone site carries wing.

kinds.app: something you use, usually with your PDS behind it
kinds.lens: reads a feed, an account, a corpus and shows you something
kinds.toy: a simulation or a generative thing you play with
kinds.explainer: a single page that teaches one result
kinds.reading: a text and an apparatus for reading it
kinds.engine: a modelling project with several faces
kinds.meta: about this site, its repo, or the loop that builds it

top.label: procgen
top.why: Pinned. Two dozen generators scattered across games, tools and data, with nothing on the landing page saying they are one genre. They share a vocabulary — a seed is a permalink, a genome is a grammar, a solver certifies, a rubric judges, local rules grow, and the output is measured against the real thing — and a trick invented in one is usable in the next. The hoop pack has its own generators and stays where it is; this is everything else. mino.mobi/procgen/ is its door.
